scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build:server-mode -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build -w web && cd desktop && tauri build
scripts.dev:server: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web -- --mode server"
